summary: Repaired a delivered easy-batch answer-position shortcut. Final easy, moderate and hard batches pass independent verification against one final package and native engine binding.

source_analysis.skill: Recognize cosine double-angle identities, double the angle, and evaluate exactly; hard adds perfect-square recognition and evaluation.
reasoning_steps: Recognize the applicable cosine double-angle identity.
Double the degree or radian argument.
Evaluate the special-angle cosine with the correct quadrant sign.
For hard expressions, factor the expanded square and square the evaluated cosine.
permitted_variations: Reference angles, quadrants, signs and legitimate zero outcomes.
Correct choice positions and plausible exact-value distractors.

a0283435-c23b-5d26-b5af-8d4a513ca18b: alternative sine identity and quadrant evaluation.

source_replay.details: All 15 source cases retain their mathematical forms, response types, complete banks and correct values. Imported questions remain unchanged.

math.details: Exact arithmetic independently verified 164 finite controls, 15 source replays, 12 counterfactual records and all 15 final records, including numerical solution rows and every choice.

variety.details: All 34 mathematical instances and 164 presentation/bank slots tested. Each final batch contains five distinct mathematical instances. Deterministic replay and capacity rejection passed.

scope.details: Every served family and response shape reaches its field-scoped key through justified displayed steps. An equivalent but unshown trig-key conversion was rejected as a negative control.

grading.details: The native grader passed 974 response checks: 330 accepted, 644 rejected and none unresolved. Includes equivalent radicals, trailing-zero zero entries, incorrect signs and stale counterfactual answers.

rendering.details: All 27 actual-UI previews passed and screenshots were inspected. Authored math spans and multiline rows match rendered nodes; emphasis and controls display correctly. Shared prose boundary validation passed.

packaging.details: Exact runtime dependencies, relocation and deterministic replay passed. Current package, engine, source, inventory and batches match the final binding. Report validation passed.

decision_variation.details: Preserved and reproduced the easy batch’s four fifth-position answers, then repaired construction with seeded per-form position cycles. Controlled pairs and conditional position, rank and sign-pair probes passed before and after delivery. Finite-family limits are documented.

progression.details: Matched angles distinguish direct recognition, alternative-identity recognition, and perfect-square recognition plus squaring. Support, response demand, source-label overlap and legitimate zero cancellation were assessed across all three bands.

easy.details: All five final records passed mathematics, grading, rendering and applicable coverage/shortcut checks; all five survive captured-inventory delivery.
